title: Canva Launches Brush, an AI Model That Edits Your Designs
dek: Canva's second in-house AI model in a week targets everyday design edits.

facts.label: People in the Canva Research AI lab

caption:
Changing every header in a 30-slide deck with one prompt? Canva just made that real. 🎨

Canva has launched Brush, a new in-house vision-language model that edits designs you already have. It reads your text, images, layout and spacing first, then writes and runs small bits of code to make changes and checks its own work in a loop. Everything stays fully editable.

Canva says Brush is up to 69% faster and 46% cheaper than its previous design agent, based on internal tests. It arrives just one week after Craft, Canva's first image-generation model. Craft makes the image, Brush refines the design around it.

We at AI Parabellum think the real story is cost: cheaper AI edits at Canva's scale could reshape the AI design race with Adobe Firefly. Brush is live now for Canva Pro users, with Brand Kit support coming next.
